div.style: display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-top:20px; z-index:30;

a.style: display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:12px 24px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, #9333ea, #4f46e5); color:#ffffff; border-radius:12px; text-decoration:none; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(168,85,247,0.5); pointer-events:auto; cursor:pointer;

div.span: Edge CDN Bridge • Click to open if not auto-redirected

iframe.allow: autoplay; fullscreen; gamepad; clipboard-read; clipboard-write; cross-origin-isolated
